title: AI Data Platform Engineer (AWS) - Manager/Senior
qualification: AWS Glue, Amazon EMR, Amazon S3, Amazon Redshift, Amazon SageMaker, Python, PySpark, SQL, Airflow (MWAA), Terraform / CloudFormation, CI/CD & Git-based development
other_details: At EY, we're looking for experienced AWS Data Platform Engineers who are passionate about building scalable, cloud-native data and AI platforms. You'll work on enterprise-scale data and AI platforms, building modern data pipelines, enabling AI/ML workloads, and driving innovation using AWS-native technologies. This is an opportunity to work on high-impact, production-grade solutions while collaborating with talented engineering and architecture teams. Benefits of joining EY include: Work on cutting-edge Data & AI initiatives, Exposure to large-scale cloud and analytics transformations, Continuous learning and professional growth, Collaborative and inclusive culture, Opportunity to shape the future of AI-enabled data platforms. If you have strong hands-on experience with AWS data engineering and are looking for your next challenge, we'd love to connect.
